If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to align with bullish momentum decay.

If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract bearish sentiment bias.

If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 2 days, add 1–2% upward bias to late horizon (16–30 days) to capture sentiment-driven breakout potential.

If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to avoid overcorrection from momentum.

If sentiment is consistently low (0.00–0.33) and forecast is trending downward, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias for mid horizon to offset bearish drift.

If sentiment is high (0.67–1.00) and forecast is flat or slightly down, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon to capture sentiment-driven rally initiation.
